lesson: 7th Grade Science · Day 1 — What Is The Periodic Table?
title: What Is The Periodic Table?

question_prompts.Q1: Before Mendeleev, some scientists organized elements alphabetically. What is the main problem with an alphabetical system?
question_prompts.Q2: Mendeleev's repeating pattern gave us the word that names the table today — the _____ table.
question_prompts.Q3: The number 11 in sodium's element box tells you that sodium has ___.
question_prompts.Q4: Why is atomic number a BETTER organizing tool than atomic mass?
question_prompts.Q5: Sodium (Na) is in Period 3. What does this tell you about its electrons?
question_prompts.Q6: Li, Na, and K are all in Group 1. What does this predict about their behavior?
question_prompts.Q7: Iron (Fe) is found in the large center-left block of the periodic table. Iron belongs to the ___.
question_prompts.Q8: Silicon conducts electricity better than a nonmetal but worse than a true metal. Silicon is most likely a ___.
